mapper.select: SELECT * FROM signal_lockup WHERE lockup_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND is_upcoming = 1 ORDER BY lockup_date ASC

SELECT sl.stock_code AS stockCode, s.stock_name AS stockName, sl.lockup_date AS lockupDate, sl.lockup_type AS lockupType, sl.shares, sl.float_ratio AS floatRatio, ROUND(sl.shares * d.close_price, 2) AS estimatedAmount FROM signal_lockup sl LEFT JOIN stock s ON sl.stock_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN stock_daily d ON sl.stock_code = d.stock_code AND d.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_daily) WHERE sl.lockup_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY sl.shares DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
